subject: english
title: Grammar Cup — Nouns & Verbs Test
subtitle: The checkpoint test for Noun Stadium and Verb Engine. Preview the 30 questions here, then assign the test to Leo. Open with ?review=1 to read back his wrong answers.

content: Check whether Leo can find nouns and verbs inside a sentence without prompting.
Check the noun sub-skills: common vs proper, the plural machines and rebels, countable vs uncountable, possessive 's, and compound nouns.
Read the round-by-round bars to see which station needs re-teaching before moving on.
language: Identify nouns, verbs, and describing words in isolation and in context.
Produce correct plurals, BE forms, the third-person -s, and simple past forms.
Choose correct word order, articles, and possessive forms.
